claim_text: For 2025 employee-only coverage, out-of-network insulin is covered at 20% coinsurance after the deductible.
document_context: Pine Valley HDHP Prescription Drug Benefits, 2025 plan year. The section describes cost sharing for covered outpatient prescription drugs obtained from participating network pharmacies. It does not specify insulin cost sharing or the treatment of prescriptions filled at out-of-network pharmacies.
evidence_excerpt: Covered outpatient prescription drugs filled at participating network pharmacies are subject to the applicable drug cost-sharing tier after the deductible.
applicability_scope: Pine Valley HDHP; 2025 employee-only coverage. The excerpt concerns covered outpatient prescriptions filled at participating network pharmacies, not out-of-network insulin.
assessment_rationale: The excerpt establishes only that applicable drug-tier cost sharing follows the deductible for prescriptions filled at participating network pharmacies. It gives neither an insulin-specific rate nor a rule for out-of-network prescriptions, so it cannot determine whether the claimed 20% coinsurance applies.
The excerpt states the $2,000 annual in-network deductible for employee-only coverage, matching the amount, period, tier, and network scope in the claim.
claim_text: For the 2025 plan year, employee-only coverage under the Cedar Ridge HDHP has an annual in-network deductible of $2,000.
document_context: Cedar Ridge HDHP Summary of Benefits, 2025 plan year. The deductible table lists separate amounts for employee-only and family coverage. The quoted row is labeled employee-only coverage and applies to in-network covered services.
evidence_excerpt: Employee-only coverage: The annual in-network deductible is $2,000 per covered member.
applicability_scope: Cedar Ridge HDHP; 2025 plan year; employee-only coverage; in-network covered services.

claim_text: For the 2025 plan year, every in-network colonoscopy is covered at no cost before the deductible, whether preventive or diagnostic.
document_context: Harbor Point HDHP Benefits Schedule, 2025 plan year. The colonoscopy section distinguishes preventive services that meet the stated guidelines from diagnostic services. The provision applies to in-network services; other plan terms may govern services outside that network.
evidence_excerpt: In-network preventive colonoscopy: no cost sharing when the service meets preventive-care guidelines. Diagnostic colonoscopy: deductible and applicable coinsurance apply.
applicability_scope: Harbor Point HDHP; 2025 plan year; in-network colonoscopies; preventive services meeting the stated guidelines versus diagnostic services.
assessment_rationale: The excerpt directly states that deductible and applicable coinsurance apply to diagnostic colonoscopies, contradicting the claim that every in-network colonoscopy is free before the deductible. The cited provision covers the plan year and in-network service scope named in the claim.
